posterior_cProfile.method: cProfile of one restored public posterior roundtrip after four warm calls; no method, hook, NumPy policy or identity changes. Native call time includes synchronization. Inclusive call times overlap and must not be summed.

interpretation: Gaussian weight/predict/resample are the largest normal-step kernels; the Doppler KF kernel is the largest KF-step component. Posterior migration includes substantial host work and transfers. cProfile exclusive Python-frame time includes NumPy ufunc work not separately visible to cProfile. Native times include synchronization; inclusive call times overlap. These diagnostics are not speedup or hardware-counter evidence.
accuracy: Every profiled output matches its unprofiled restored snapshot. Long real-data positioning accuracy was not newly measured.
